name: ATECH
recent: Aurelius Technologies Berhad 近期公告主要涉及董事 Tan Chong Hin 在闭市期间的交易，以及 EPF 作为大股东的持股变动。公司最新季度（2026年6月30日）营收环比增长8.5%，但同比下滑13.2%。
notable: 执行董事兼集团首席财务官 Tan Chong Hin 在闭市期间进行股份交易，涉及327,900股普通股。
EPF 在2026年9月至10月期间多次申报作为大股东的持股变动。
公司于2026年9月1日调整多个董事会委员会成员，包括提名、风险、审计与薪酬委员会。
risks: 执行董事 Tan Chong Hin 在闭市期间进行股份交易，涉及327,900股。
EPF 作为大股东在近期多次申报持股变动，显示其持股比例有所调整。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为141,461,401令吉，环比增长8.5%，同比下滑13.2%；净利为11,262,371令吉，环比增长22.7%，同比下滑31.2%；净利率为8.0%，高于上一季度的7.0%。

recent_en: Aurelius Technologies Berhad's recent announcements mainly involve dealings by Director Tan Chong Hin during the closed period and changes in EPF's substantial shareholder interest. The latest quarter (30 June 2026) saw revenue rise 8.5% QoQ but fall 13.2% YoY.
notable_en: Executive Director and Group CFO Tan Chong Hin dealt 327,900 ordinary shares during the closed period.
EPF filed multiple substantial shareholder interest changes between September and October 2026.
The company changed members of several board committees, including nomination, risk, audit and remuneration committees, on 1 September 2026.
risks_en: Executive Director Tan Chong Hin dealt 327,900 shares during the closed period.
EPF, a substantial shareholder, filed multiple changes in its shareholding recently, indicating adjustments to its stake.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR141,461,401, up 8.5% QoQ but down 13.2% YoY; net income was MYR11,262,371, up 22.7% QoQ but down 31.2% YoY; net margin was 8.0%, higher than 7.0% in the previous quarter.
